title: Story premise ENT019: The Bigger Welcome Mat
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: Welcome. More welcome. Maximum welcome. Takeaway/theme: More promotion can mean less clarity.
description: Two shopkeepers compete with longer welcome mats until the mats cover the whole square and nobody can tell which shop is which. They cut the mats into two clear pathways and leave a shared open patch where a lost customer can finally choose.
